name: Lou Lou
source:
Head of the "fifth fortress" and a greatly powerful warrior.

She has no problem wielding greataxes the size of her own body. This, coupled with her nimbleness as a halfling, allows her to easily topple even trolls five times her size.

A sassy girl with small breasts, and a contrarian at heart with a sharp tongue. Her emotions change at the drop of a hat. She can go from pouty, to upset, to mad in the span of just a few moments.

She’ll attack anyone who goes after her and will fight back with everything she has. However, she’ll quickly break into tears and become frightened once she’s been overwhelmed, and won’t hesitate to scream.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1058]MangaGamer[/url]]
